title: Security of services for French public authorities (RGS, homologation, SecNumCloud)
description: Preselected for the public sector: keep it when the product, or the hosting it runs on, is delivered to a French administrative authority or to the State, which carry the RGS, the security homologation and, for sensitive data, the State's cloud doctrine; decline it outside France or for a private customer. Local authorities and private customers may fall under the RGS alone or under none of these texts. It adds to nis2-essential-entity (EU).
